import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='e0yOWue'].copy()

# per row: for each resource dimension, compare 10/13 vs previous days
d13 = acc[acc.date=='10/13/25'].copy()
hist = acc[acc.date!='10/13/25']

for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    prev = hist.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()
    cur = d13.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()
    diff = (cur - prev).sort_values(ascending=False)
    print(col, 'top increases:')
    print(diff.head(8))
    print()
